Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a significant shift of the mediastinum and trachea to the right (away from the affected side). In the context of pyo-pneumothorax, this indicates a massive pleural effusion (pyothorax) exerting mass effect, pushing structures to the contralateral side, whereas atelectasis or collapse would pull the mediastinum toward the opacity.
